name: codex-api
specialty: Pay-as-you-go Codex on its own OpenAI project key: independent read-only second opinions.
notes: Runs `codex exec -m gpt-6.1-sol --sandbox read-only --json`; the sandbox is read-only for every role, so this agent never writes.

CODEX_API_KEY (what codex exec reads; not OPENAI_API_KEY) is set only in this child's environment. CODEX_HOME is the agent's own folder (agents-home/codex-api) holding a config.toml with forced_login_method = "api", written on first launch when missing, so it cannot fall back to a ChatGPT login.
Run codex exec with stdin from /dev/null; otherwise it waits on "Reading additional input from stdin".
codex has no per-run budget flag, so the $0.50 per-run rule is advisory here; the daily cap still applies through the spend ledger when a cost is known. Set a spend cap on the OpenAI project.
